C1.worst_defect: Home never says who builds or supports this or who runs the hosted till: the only maintainer signal is the footer 'MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI. For Medusa, see MedusaPOS.' A sceptic weighing it against Shopify POS or Square gets no answer to 'who is behind this and will it be here next year?'

C2.worst_defect: 'MIT licensed' is undercut by 'Building it yourself needs your own RxDB Premium licence token in RXDB_PREMIUM'. No price, link or reason is given, so in practice you depend on app.vendurepos.com, whose operator, cost and continuity are never stated. The demo also shows more than a real store gets: refund at the till is 'No, not on plugin 0.3.0' for your store, and the customer note is demo-only ('On plugin 0.3.0, Order details has no customer note'), yet the home comparison table leaves the note out
C2.where: home 'Before you start'; connect-a-till 'Where requests go'; limitations 'Setting up the store'; at-the-till

C3.worst_defect: A known gap is pushed onto the user in prose instead of being fixed: 'On plugin 0.3.0 that role has no ReadOrder: add it yourself, or the till sells but its order history is refused'. Step 8 also sends you off mid-flow to Plugin setup to 'swap its order-confirmation handler first', and 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app' is never explained
C3.where: quick-start steps 5, 8 and sign-in; connect-a-till 'Give each cashier their own account'

C4.worst_defect: Only At the till has screenshots. Quick start has no image of the sign-in screen or of a finished sale, the ReadOrder caveat is repeated on four pages, and the Changelog is internal jargon ('order.create v5', 'ADR 0005', migration class names like 'TallyPosV51790900000000') with no changelog for the till app

C5.worst_defect: The home hero screenshot of the till is small and dense at 1440 px, so its detail can't be read, and 'What it does today' is a grid of 10 near-identical cards with no visual hierarchy

C6.worst_defect: The 404 page leaves about 60% of the screen empty below 'Home / Docs / Live demo', and long quick-start headings wrap to three lines

C7.worst_defect: The OG image crops the till screenshot at the bottom edge. Everything else is clean: Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, CLS 0, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD and the search API all work

overall_worst.defect: The site sells itself as 'MIT licensed' open source, but building the till yourself 'needs your own RxDB Premium licence token in RXDB_PREMIUM', a paid proprietary dependency with no price, link or explanation. The alternative is the hosted app.vendurepos.com, and the site never says who runs it, whether it stays free or what happens if it goes away. A sceptic comparing it with Square or Shopify POS reads this as lock-in dressed as open source.
overall_worst.where: home 'Before you start' (desktop slice 02, phone slice 05); connect-a-till 'Where requests go'; limitations 'Setting up the store'
overall_worst.fix: Next to the RXDB_PREMIUM bullet, link RxDB Premium's licence and price and say why it is needed. Add one line saying who operates app.vendurepos.com, that it is free, and that the static build can be self-hosted if it disappears. Better: ship a self-build fallback on free RxDB storage.
